config.decision_rule: suggest_exclude when >=90% of unchanged mask pixels have argmax in excluded classes AND softmax max >=0.7; retain when >=90% are confident nonexcluded; otherwise review and operationally retain
config.preprocess: official SegformerImageProcessor config; whole RGB frame resized to 640x640; no crop
config.postprocess: bilinear resize float32 logits to original H,W, align_corners=False, then softmax/argmax; direct model id2label with no label offset
config.sensitivity_policy: descriptive only; original 0.7/0.9 decisions frozen before comparison
